surface_verification.justification: monorepo compliance-tooling change (a new per-FR Layers-promotion mechanism + its own tests); no startable web/dev-server/CLI surface of its own to browser-verify -- verification is the unit/integration test suite itself (F0), including a real, verified-idempotent run of the new CLI against this repo's own spec.md and manifest.

behaviors.behavior: promotion happens automatically for a clean FR with no operator interaction, with the evidence (highest observable layer) named in the ledger entry
no batch/sweep path exists: one FR's escalation never blocks a sibling FR's clean promotion in the same run
a bound-but-unexecuted test escalates unconditionally (absent != green), regardless of rank relative to the highest passing layer
an existing required layer without fresh ok evidence blocks promotion even when a different layer is newly green
a collision (ambiguous display id) escalates layer_undeterminable, and only an operator's recorded demoted/promoted decision clears it on a re-run
a promoted FR cannot silently demote: a hand-narrowed explicit cell (still nominally 'explicit') escalates contradicts_recorded_decision rather than a clean skip

the automated tool never overrides an operator's recorded demotion: unchanged evidence stays a decided skip, and evidence that newly looks green escalates to a human rather than silently promoting (Stage-1 spec-review round 2, P3.5: replaces a deleted test with the two that now jointly cover both halves)
the human-only CLI hardcodes decided_by=operator; an unrecognised --decided-by flag is rejected by argparse itself
a re-run over an already-promoted FR is a clean, byte-identical no-op (idempotent), never a second write or ledger entry
the ledger is written before spec.md on both the automated tool and the human CLI, so a ledger-write failure never leaves an unrecorded promoted cell
a concurrent edit to spec.md between planning and writing a promotion is detected and refused, never silently overwritten
escalating over half the evaluated set surfaces a sweep_signal_warning report without changing the exit-code contract
the repo-wide guard pinning every live FR to legacy provenance recognizes a ledger-recorded promotion as the one legitimate exception, and still hard-fails an unrecorded/accidental flip

LAYER_RANK is a direct re-export of tools.verifiers._layer_coverage_binding._LAYER_RANK, not an independent copy -- a canonical layer added upstream cannot silently diverge the promoter from the gate it promotes into
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_layer_promotion.py (full 35-test file re-run green after the re-export fix; highest_ok_layer delegates directly)

behaviors.behavior: the lock-release test is mechanism-sensitive, not merely outcome-sensitive: deleting main()'s finally: lock_cm.__exit__(...) makes the (restructured) test fail, not merely leaves it green via GeneratorExit refcount cleanup
behaviors.evidence: shared/scripts/tools/tests/test_promote_required_layers.py::test_an_exception_inside_the_locked_span_still_releases_the_lock and its twin in test_record_layer_promotion_decision.py -- both empirically verified to fail (real LockTimeout after a 10s wait) when the finally block is manually removed, then restored

behaviors.behavior: record_layer_promotion_decision.py's promoted branch widens OSError handling to match its demoted sibling, and rejects a missing/empty spec_path by name before resolving it
a type-corrupted ledger required_layers element (e.g. null) fails closed with ValueError, not a raw AttributeError

a ledger entry with an unrecognised action value (a typo, or a foreign value) fails closed with ValueError naming the FR id at load time, rather than silently falling through evaluate_fr as if the FR had no ledger entry at all
a corrupted decisions[fr_id] value (not a list, or a list of non-dict entries) fails closed with ValueError naming the FR id, not a raw AttributeError/KeyError

a promoted ledger entry with a corrupted required_layers element (e.g. null) fails closed at load time with a normal CLI JSON error shape (rc 2, an error key naming the FR id), not an uncaught traceback
behaviors.evidence: shared/scripts/tools/tests/test_promote_required_layers.py::test_a_corrupted_ledger_required_layers_is_an_operational_failure, alongside the lib-level shared/tests/test_layer_promotion.py pin of the underlying _canonical_layer_tokens behavior

behaviors.behavior: a promotable FR whose live spec.md cell still carries a hand-added annotation or non-canonical token is skipped, instead of the automated tool's rewrite silently deleting the text with no warning (Stage-1 spec-review REJECT, P3.5 post-push round: corrected from an escalation to a named skip -- the predicate demonstrably holds, so this is not one of the spec's three named undecidable cases)

an OSError while reading the layer-promotion ledger (a permissions error, or the path becoming a directory) surfaces as this CLI's normal error shape in both the automated and operator CLIs, not an uncaught traceback

evidence_fingerprint's agreement between evaluate_fr's mutated eval_node and plan_promotions' own reporting node is pinned directly, so a future widening of the fingerprint payload (e.g. to include required_layers) fails loudly here instead of silently diverging in production

a spec.md write failure on the demote-revert path names the ledger-recorded/cell-still-explicit state and tells the operator the same --action demoted command will retry and clear it (the opposite framing from the automated tool's own matching message, which must warn a re-run will NOT clear it)

a promotion's whole-row rewrite is value-preserving but not byte-preserving for an untouched sibling cell (a hand-written backslash re-escapes; hand-added column-alignment padding collapses) -- accepted-not-fixed (Stage-3 doubt-review round 3, P3.5 post-push round), pinned as an explicit tested contract rather than left an untested side effect

evidence_fingerprint's digest is stable under reordering of two test links sharing id/path/ac_id but differing only in tag_source (a total-order gap in _link_sort_key, Stage-3 doubt-review round 3, P3.5 post-push round)
